WITH TMP AS( SELECT B.BOOKSET_ID,/**账套 -账套代码**/ B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,/**账套-核算主体代码**/ b.ACCT_SUBJECt_type FINPROD_TYPE,/**账套-核算主体类型**/ b.start_date, /**账套开始日 **/ b.end_date, /**账套结束日 **/ B.STANDARD_CCY,/**账套-本位币**/ H.BOOKSET_DATE,/**账套日期**/ H.BOOK_DATE/**入账日期**/ ,H.IS_SUB_BOOKSET FROM BOK_BOOKSET B/**账套表**/ INNER JOIN BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO H/**批处理待处理任务表**/ ON B.BOOKSET_ID=H.BOOKSET_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND H.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND H.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND H.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND H.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND H.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND H.HAPPEN_DATE >= TO_DATE('2018-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') AND H.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} ) SELECT
F.CASH_ID cashId, /**现金流代码**/ F.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ F.CASH_TYPE_2 cashType2, /**现金流二级类型**/ G.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, /**账套代码**/ G.BOOKSET_DATE booksetDate, /**账套日期**/ G.BOOK_DATE bookDate, /**入账日期**/ G.STANDARD_CCY standardCcy, /**本位币**/ g.FINPROD_ID finprodId, /** 核算主体代码 **/ g.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, /** 核算主体类别 **/ g.START_DATE startDate, /** 账套开始日 **/ g.END_DATE endDate, /** 账套结束日 **/ VBD.BOK_DETAIL_ID, /**业务明细代码**/ g.FINPROD_ID AS busiId, g.IS_SUB_BOOKSET FROM
TMP G
INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO F ON g.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID
AND F.CASH_TYPE_2 IN
#{cashType}
INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID VBD ON g.FINPROD_ID = VBD.BUSI_ID AND g.FINPROD_TYPE = VBD.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE and g.BOOKSET_ID = VBD.BOOKSET_ID
WHERE 1=1 and g.start_date<=#{HAPPEN_DATE} AND g.end_date>=#{HAPPEN_DATE}

mapper.select: WITH DEDUCTED_TAX AS ( SELECT tdb.BOK_DETAIL_ID, /* 账务明细代码 */ tdb.CB_BALANCE, /* 待抵扣资产份额余额 */ tdb.BAL_AMT /* 待抵扣增值税余额 */ FROM TAX_DEDUCTED_BALANCE tdb WHERE (tdb.BOOK_ORDER, tdb.BOK_DETAIL_ID) IN ( SELECT MAX(tdb1.BOOK_ORDER) BOOK_ORDER, tdb1.BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM TAX_DEDUCTED_BALANCE tdb1 WHERE tdb1.HAPPEN_DATE <= #{happenDate,jdbcType=DATE} - 1 AND tdb1.BOOK_DATE <= #{bookDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND tdb1.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY tdb1.BOK_DETAIL_ID ) ) SELECT NVL(dt.BAL_AMT, ttb.INCOME_AMT) incomeAmt, NVL(dt.CB_BALANCE, ttb.CB_AMT) cbAmt, ttb.BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM TAX_TURNED_BALANCE ttb LEFT JOIN DEDUCTED_TAX dt ON ( ttb.BOK_DETAIL_ID = dt.BOK_DETAIL_ID ) WHERE NVL(dt.BAL_AMT, ttb.INCOME_AMT) != 0
